statics.name: BASIC
statics.description: Asset path for the built-in basic shader.

statics.name: MINIMAL
statics.description: Asset path for the built-in minimal shader.

statics.name: SKY
statics.description: Asset path for the built-in sky panorama shader.

statics.name: PRAGMA_FOXFLAGS
statics.description: Pragma marker replaced with the shader's define flags during compilation.

statics.name: PRAGMA_SHADOW_PROGRAM
statics.description: Pragma marker used to detect the shadow-pass program check.

statics.name: PRAGMA_OPENGL3
statics.description: Pragma marker replaced with the OpenGL 3 (or WebGL) version directive.

statics.name: PRAGMA_OPENGL4
statics.description: Pragma marker replaced with the OpenGL 4 version directive (desktop only).

statics.name: OPENGL3_VERSION_ES
statics.description: GLSL version directive for OpenGL ES / WebGL (#version 300 es).

statics.name: OPENGL4_VERSION
statics.description: GLSL version directive for OpenGL 4, desktop platforms only (#version 450).

statics.name: GLOBAL_FLAGS
statics.description: Shader flags applied to every shader in addition to the ones passed explicitly.

members.name: shadow
members.description: Version of this shader used for the shadow pass only.

members.name: assetsKey
members.description: The asset name this shader was loaded from, used as its cache key.

members.name: program
members.description: The compiled Program3D backing this shader.

members.name: textureInput
members.description: Texture sampler uniforms set on this shader, read when rendering.

members.name: uniformCache
members.description: Cache of active uniform locations, types and sizes for this shader's program.

members.name: shaderDefines
members.description: The preprocessor flags used to compile this shader.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Creates a new, uncompiled FoxShader.

functions.name: fromSources
functions.description: Creates (or fills) a FoxShader from raw vertex and fragment sources, processing #include directives and foxlite pragmas, then compiles it along with its shadow-pass variant.

functions.name: processIncludes
functions.description: Resolves #include directives in a shader source, using FoxLoaderUtil to load and cache the included files.

functions.name: fromAsset
functions.description: Loads a shader by asset name and flags, returning a cached instance if one already exists for that combination.

functions.name: defineName
functions.description: Sanitizes a name into a valid preprocessor #define identifier.

functions.name: compile
functions.description: Compiles this shader's vertex and fragment sources and initializes its uniform/attribute cache. While uncompiled, no uniform should be set or they will be lost.

functions.name: initCache
functions.description: Rebuilds the uniform and attribute location caches from the compiled program.

functions.name: combine
functions.description: Combines the fragment program from shaderA with the vertex program from shaderB into a new shader, without recompiling sources. Since it reuses the other shaders' programs, destroy() won't delete them, so destroying shaderA or shaderB afterwards will break this shader.

functions.name: sanitizeFlags
functions.description: Normalizes, deduplicates and sorts a list of shader flags, merging in GLOBAL_FLAGS.

functions.name: recompile
functions.description: Recompiles this shader using its cached vert/frag sources, optionally with a new flags array. Reuses a cached program if one exists for the resulting flag combination.

functions.name: getVertexShaderLog
functions.description: Returns the compile log for this shader's vertex program.

functions.name: getFragmentShaderLog
functions.description: Returns the compile log for this shader's fragment program.

functions.name: setFloat
functions.description: Sets a float uniform by name.

functions.name: setInt
functions.description: Sets an int uniform by name.

functions.name: setBool
functions.description: Sets a bool uniform by name.

functions.name: setSampler2D
functions.description: Sets a sampler2D texture input by uniform name. Pass null to remove it.

functions.name: setFloatArray
functions.description: Sets a float, vecN or matN uniform (including arrays) by name.

functions.name: setIntArray
functions.description: Sets an int, ivecN or bvecN uniform (including arrays) by name.

functions.name: setBoolArray
functions.description: Sets a bool, bvec2, bvec3 or bvec4 uniform by name.

functions.name: setVector2
functions.description: Sets a vec2 uniform from a Vector2.

functions.name: setVector3
functions.description: Sets a vec3 uniform from a Vector3D.

functions.name: setVector4
functions.description: Sets a vec4 uniform from an object exposing x, y, z and w fields.

functions.name: setMatrix4
functions.description: Sets a mat4 uniform from a Matrix3D.

functions.name: setMatrix4Array_Raw
functions.description: Sets a mat4 array uniform from a raw Float32Array.

functions.name: getGLProgram
functions.description: Returns the underlying native GL program handle for this shader.

functions.name: getGLShadowProgram
functions.description: Returns the underlying native GL program handle for this shader's shadow pass.

functions.name: disposeProgram
functions.description: Disposes this shader's GPU program (unless combined, in which case only references are cleared) and its shadow program.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Disposes the program, clears texture and uniform caches, removes this shader from the cache, and destroys its shadow shader.
